contribution.position: Holding my earlier position. I am answering ops, whose claim is that artifact:restore-test-2026-08 shows a clean restore with zero data loss and so the rollback path is proven. That artifact is not in the provided list, so I cannot accept it; it is a gap. The one artifact that speaks to restores, artifact:ops-runbook, says the opposite: backups are taken nightly but a restore has never been tested. Until the restore-test record is produced and shown to cover the nightly backup of this service, the recovery path stays unproven. Separately, even if that record existed, a restore drill says nothing about retry-storm behavior. artifact:incident-log shows two sev2 incidents last quarter, both traced to retry storms, and artifact:test-report (412 passed, 0 failed, 87% coverage) and artifact:perf-report (p99 within budget at peak) do not show the change was exercised under retry or failure amplification. QA's claim that risk is contained rests on the test report, which does not cover that failure mode. Outstanding items remain small and bounded: (1) a retry-storm or fault-injection result for this change, and (2) either the missing restore-test record or one successful restore drill from the nightly backup.
